book.name: Mako
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Mako

content: Yesu alongela panani ja kuyonangeka kwa Nyumba jaka Chapanga
Yesu paakabhi apita mu Nyumba jaka Chapanga, jumu wa bhabhulwa bhaki akumpwaghile, “Mbola, lingalyaje ntundu maganga aghagha na machengu aghagha moghabheli gha kukangacha!”
Yesu akumpwaghile, “Bho, mughabhona machengu aghagha moghakolile? Njeta hata liganga limu lelihighalya panani ja lenge, kila chindu anachihabhukaje.”
Kulyunga na kulaga
Yesu paakabhi atemi panani ja Chitombi cha Mizeituni akalingali upambala wa Nyumba jaka Chapanga, Petulu, Yakobo, Yohana na Andulea bhakundaluki pakanjika jabho,
“Tupwaghilaje, bho, mambu ghanihagha ghibya lile? Bho, nginyuli bholi yeilangiaje kubha mambu ghanihagha ghaheghali kupitalila?”
Yesu akatumbwi kubhapwaghila, “Mlilingalyaje mundu ngaankolowa.
Maghambu bhandu bhamaheli anabhahikaje kwa lihina langu, kila jumu wabhu anaapwaghaje, ‘Nepani nde jombi!’ Na bhombi anabhakoluwaje bhandu bhamahele.
Pamwijowana panani ja ngondo na majojalanelu gha ngondo, ngamwijoghopa. Mambu ghanihagha anaghatumbula kupitalila, nambu ujomukelu weni wibya wakali.

Likabila limu analikomana na likabila lenge, ukolongwa ghumu anaukomana na ukolongwa ghonge. Pandu patalipatali anakukubhaje na minyukunyuku ja luhombi na injala. Mambu ghanihagha nde ngati mabhinilu gha kutumbula gha kulibhopo mwana.

“Nambu mwenga mulilingalyaje. Maghambu bhandu anabhumpelaka pachengu, na kundapu iboku mu nyumba ya kuhimangani Bhayahude. Anabhumpelaka palongi ja bhatawala na bhakolongwa kwa ndandi jangu, nahuli kubha ulandilu kwabho.
Nambu anaghatumbula hoti Malobhi Manyahi kutangazwa kwa bhandu bha mataifa ghokapi.

Na bhombi pabhunkamulaje na kumpeleka pachengu, ngamwihola panani ja malobhi ghamwilongilaje. Pachihikaje chikahi chenihechi, ndongila chokapi chemwipekiwaje. Ndandi nga mwanganya mwemwilongilaje, nambu Roho Mhuhu.
Mbeli anaang'anambuka nnung'una waki akomakikaje, na tati anahenga bhelabhela kwa bhana bhaki, na bhana anabhang'anambukaje kubhalapula bhabheleka bhabhu na kubhakoma.
Bhandu bhamaheli anabhunhakalya mwenga kwa ndandi ja lihina langu. Nambu joanahinakyaje mbaka pakujomukela nde joanakengaliwaje.
Kulagha kukolongwa
“Pamwibhona, ‘Lihakalilu la Uyonangeku,’ ngati molalembakike na mlota Danieli, lijemiki pandu nga paki.” Joasoma na amanya ndandi jake. “Panihapa, bhabhabhi ku Yudea bhatililaje kwitombi.
Mundu jokapi jola joabhi panani ja nhwaghala wa nyumba jaki ngayihuluka, na kujingila mkati ja nyumba jaki na kutola chindu!
Bhelabhela joabhi kungonda ngaikelabhuka kunyumba jaki na kutola ingobhu jaki.
Anabhachibhona akamabhu bhabhikubhaje na hitumbu, na bhabhajongeha mu machobha ghanihagha!
Ndobhaje nahuli mambu ghanihagha ngaghipitalila chikahi cha imbepu.
Ndandi chikahi hechi anakubya na kulagha kwanga kubhonikana kutumbu Chapanga paakabhombiki ndema mbaka lalenu, na wala ngaghipitali kabheti.
Ngati Bambo ngaakakepishi machobha ghanihagha nga mundu joakakengaliwaje. Nambu kwa ndandi ja bhandu bhaki bhahaghulika, Bambo akepishi machobha ghanihagha.
“Henu mundu anampwaghi, ‘Lingalyaje, Kristo abhi apa,’ au ‘Abhi pala,’ ngamwihobhalela.
Kwa ndandi anabhapitalyaje maklisto bha upuhe na bhalota bha upuhe, anabhatenda nginyulila na mambu gha kukangacha, nahuli kubhakolowa, ngati anaiwezakini, hata bhahaghulika bhaka Chapanga.
Nambu mwenga mulilingalyaje! Nepani numpwaghi mambu ghanihagha ghokapi koni ghakona ngakupitalila.
Kuhika kwaka Mwana waka Mundu
“Bhela paghipetaje machobha ghanihagha gha kulagha, lyobha analiyeghalika lwihi na mwehi ngawinang'ane.
Ndondwa anaihabhukaje kuhuma kunani kumahunde, na hindu yokapi ya kunani anainyuhakikaje.
Panihapa mwimona nepani, Mwana waka Mundu, nhika mu mahundi kwa makili makolongwa na ulumbalilu.
Kabheti ananabhalaghalakya bhatumika bhangu bha kunani kumahunde bhabhonganaje bhahaghulika bhaka Chapanga kuhuma ipambala yokapi nchechi ya ndema. Hata kuhuma kutali nakanopi ja pundema.
Libholu la nkongu wa mtini
“Kwa nkongu wa mtini mulibhola libholu lendenu. Chikahi mambandi ghaki paghatumbu kutunduli mahamba na kuneng'anela, mmanya chikahi cha mahunu chiheghalile.
Bhelabhela, na mwenga pamughabhona mambu ghanihagha ghahengakeka, mmanyaje kubha Mwana waka Mundu abhi pambipi kuhika.
Numpwaghi chakaka, chibheleku chenjenu ngachipeti, mbaka mambu ghanihagha ghokapi ghapitalile.
Kunani na pundema anaipetaje, nambu malobhi ghangu ngaghipeti ng'o.
Chapanga kanjika jaki amanyi lichobha la kujomukela
“Nambu panani ja lichobha la kujomukela, na lisaa lela, nga mundu joamanyi analihika lile, wala bhatumika bha kunani kwaka Chapanga, wala Mwana. Nambu Atati kanjika jaki nde joamanya.
Muliandiaje na mkubhaje mihu, ndandi ngachemmanyi chikahi hechi anachihika lile.
Kwibya ngati mundu joabhoka panyumba kutumbu mwanja akabhalekila bhatumika bhaki kujilingalila, kila mundu na lihengu laki na kumpwaghi mlonda wa ndyangu akubha mihu.
Mkubhaje mihu, ndandi ngachemmanyi mweni nyumba anahika lile. Pangi kwibya pakamihi, au ikilu pamahiku, au pachibhombu au palukela.
Muliandiaje, nahuli anahiki kwa kupwitukila, ngaanhimani ngochile.
Malobhi ghanumpwaghi mabhanganya, numpwaghi mabhokapi. Mkubhaje mihu!”
